text:
emily.finance: Ping 11 CardioPulse put a renewal invoice (INV-2026-1302) on hold. They say the platform fee appears twice and the renewal price is higher than quote. Can someone pull metering and contract history?

nate.revops: I'll grab the metering export and contract timeline. Do we have the renewal addendum?

ravi.am: Customer executed an early renewal on 2026-04-01 to lock pricing, but they also spun up a temporary sandbox instance for integration testing on 2026-04-15 that should have been billed as a trial. Possible SKU duplication between contract renewals and trials.

emily.finance: Invoice lines copied below:
```
INV-2026-1302
 - PRIVATE-LICENSE-CP-01 qty 1 $22,000 annual
 - PLATFORM-FEE-CP-01 qty 1 $22,000 annual
 - SUPPORT-PREM-CP qty 1 $6,600 annual
 - PLATFORM-FEE-CP-01 qty 1 $22,000 annual (duplicate?)
 - TRIAL-SANDBOX-CP qty 1 $0 desc: sandbox trial (shouldn't bill)
```

sara.billing: Billing export uploaded: /billing/exports/2026-05/cardiopulse_20260504.csv by billing-scheduler at 2026-05-04T08:12Z

billing-bot: [system] Metering export available at /billing/exports/2026-05/cardiopulse_20260504.csv

sara.billing: I inspected the export. There are three records: active renewal commit R-900 (start 2026-04-01), legacy commit L-400 (end 2026-04-30) and trial commit T-TRIAL (2026-04-15 -> 2026-04-22). The migration job created a new PLATFORM_FEE SKU for R-900 but did not retire the legacy platform_fee for L-400; the trial also incorrectly mapped to PLATFORM_FEE instead of TRIAL-SANDBOX SKU in the billing mapping.

nate.revops: Ugh. Two separate mapping bugs: (1) migration did not emit an end_date for legacy platform_fee when renewals are early; (2) trial mapping mis-classified the sandbox as platform-fee. I'll open ENG-4591 and ENG-4592.

eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4591 created by nate.revops: "migration tool failing to retire legacy platform_fee on early renewal" https://eng.redwood/ENG-4591
eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4592 created by nate.revops: "trial mapping incorrectly labeled sandbox as platform_fee SKU" https://eng.redwood/ENG-4592

ravi.am: Customer expectation: early renewal should replace legacy platform fee (no overlap) and sandbox trial should be $0. They flagged the invoice to procurement and are holding payment. Need corrected invoice + credit memo. Also must honor the locked renewal pricing.

emily.finance: Sara, please compute prorates and trial credit. Ravi, can you confirm the renewal addendum signature date?

ravi.am: Confirmed signed 2026-04-01 at 14:03 UTC. SEs confirmed sandbox was explicitly set as trial 2026-04-15 in the onboarding notes. I'll forward sign-off.

sara.billing: Calculations: PLATFORM fee $22,000 annual -> daily $60.2739. Duplicate overlap period (2026-04-15 -> 2026-04-30) 16 days -> $964.38 duplicate charge. Trial mis-billed full platform fee 7 days -> $421.92 should be $0 -> credit $421.92. Support proration: premium $6,600 annual -> daily $18.0822; we billed full year but renewal locked price should apply; support was correctly applied to renewal so no change. Total credit needed = $964.38 + $421.92 = $1,386.30. Drafting CREDIT-2026-0527 and corrected invoice INV-2026-1302A.

emily.finance: Approve draft credit memo. Nate, please prioritize ENG-4591/4592 and add unit tests: one to assert legacy SKUs get end_date on early renewals, another to assert trial SKUs map to TRIAL-SANDBOX. Also run a quick scan for other early-renewal customers in last 60 days.

nate.revops: Will do; patching migration and billing-mapper repos. Canary run for 72h. Running scan now.

eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4591 status set to "in review" by nate.revops
eng-ticket-bot: [system] ENG-4592 status set to "in review" by nate.revops

sara.billing: Credit applied and INV-2026-1302A issued to portal 2026-05-04T17:45Z. CREDIT-2026-0527 uploaded to /billing/credits. Notified account team.

ravi.am: Customer responded: "Thanks for the prompt fix and credit. We'll release payment once portal shows corrected invoice." :thumbsup:

emily.finance: Thanks all. Nate, share scan results in tomorrow's ops sync and tag me if any other customers show overlap. Closing thread.
